intro: The Cook Islands Scholars Database & Dashboard is a sister project to the Tongan and Fijian Scholars Databases & Dashboards, curated by Assistant Professor Ron Vave at the University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa. It highlights the scholarly research and contributions of Cook Islands postgraduates and researchers, in the Cook Islands and around the world.
